metadata.title: Monthly social media management
metadata.description: Strategy, calendar, filming, editing, publishing and monthly reporting for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or LinkedIn, with a minimum commitment of three months.

hero.conturile_tale_de_social_media_luna_de_l: Your social media accounts, month by month. We plan, write, film, edit and publish. You receive the results in a report you can read in five minutes.

ce_primesti.stii_de_la_inceputul_lunii_ce_iese_cand: You know from the start of the month what goes out, when and why.
ce_primesti.gandite_pentru_telefon_nu_adaptate_din_a: Designed for mobile, not adapted from other assets. Of these, 6-8 are videos.
ce_primesti.filmam_tot_continutul_lunii_intr_o_singu: We film all of the month’s content in a single day, so it doesn’t take over your entire month.
ce_primesti.postam_noi_pe_instagram_tiktok_facebook: We publish on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or LinkedIn across the channels agreed together.
ce_primesti.ce_a_mers_ce_nu_si_ce_schimbam_luna_viit: What worked, what didn’t and what we’ll change next month.
ce_primesti.atat_ii_trebuie_unui_cont_ca_sa_se_vada: That is how long an account needs for a measurable change to become visible.

pentru_cine_e.marketing_managerii_care_au_deja_agentie: Marketing managers who already have an agency but don’t have content designed for mobile.
pentru_cine_e.antreprenorii_care_vor_sa_posteze_consta: Entrepreneurs who want to post consistently without doing everything themselves.
pentru_cine_e.brandurile_care_vor_sa_apara_cu_oameni_n: Brands that want to feature people, not just products.
pentru_cine_e.lavinia_face_strategia_bianca_scrie_film: Lavinia handles strategy and Bianca writes. We both film and edit.

cum_decurge.ne_spui_unde_esti_si_unde_vrei_sa_ajungi: Tell us where you are and where you want to get.
cum_decurge.strategia_si_calendarul_aprobate_de_tine: Strategy and calendar, approved by you.
cum_decurge.filmam_tot_continutul_lunii: We film all of the month’s content.
cum_decurge.postam_masuram_si_iti_trimitem_raportul: We publish, measure and send you the report.

intrebari.de_ce_minimum_3_luni_la_lunar: Why a minimum of 3 months for Lunar?
intrebari.in_prima_luna_testam_formate_ore_ton_rez: In the first month we test formats, posting times and tone. Measurable results appear once the audience starts to recognize you. Under 3 months, you pay more for the launch than for the results.
intrebari.ce_trebuie_sa_fac_eu: What do I need to do?
intrebari.o_discutie_la_inceput_o_zi_pe_luna_pentr: One conversation at the start, one day per month for filming and five minutes for the report. The rest is on us.
intrebari.depinde_de_cate_canale_ai_si_de_ce_conti: It depends on how many channels you have and what content you need. We agree on it together and put it in writing, with no surprises.
intrebari.am_deja_o_agentie_putem_lucra_impreuna: I already have an agency. Can we work together?
intrebari.da_preluam_partea_de_social_media_si_luc: Yes. We take over the social media side and work with your agency, not instead of it.

celelalte_servicii.filmam_editam_facem_continut_adevarat_cl: We film and edit real content: clips and photos designed for mobile and ready to post.
celelalte_servicii.tot_ce_ai_online_radiografiat_plan_de_90: Everything you have online, reviewed. A 90-day plan on one page, in 10 days.
celelalte_servicii.cont_setat_directie_creativa_primele_8_c: Account setup, creative direction, the first 8 clips and a playbook for your team.
celelalte_servicii.emailuri_automate_campanii_si_o_lista_ca: Automated emails, campaigns and a growing list.
celelalte_servicii.pachete_personalizate_cu_artistii_nostri: Custom packages with our artists: painting, clay and whatever else your brand needs.

ne_vedem_la_cafea.vorbim_deschis_despre_ce_ai_nevoie_si_ca: We’ll talk openly about what you need and what it costs. And yes, the coffee is on us.
